rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for deliberately giving someone or something no attention.

example.english: I've been talking for so long, and you still ignore me.
example.traditional: 我講咗咁耐，你仲唔理我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 zo2 gam3 noi6 nei5 zung6 m4 lei5 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately refuses to listen.

example.english: I called you several times, but you still ignore me.
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 nei5 gei2 ci3 nei5 dou1 m4 teng1

rows.note: Use this when someone pretends not to see or notice a person or thing, especially visually.

example.english: They saw me on the street but pretended to ignore me.
example.traditional: 佢喺街見到我，竟然扮睇唔到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 ging2 jin4 baan6 tai2 m4 dou2
